# NEW 2026-11-19 Yuan track Y7 (the late-Yuan suppression of the Red Turbans, oe_y7_). Generated by gen_yuan_y7.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Debug counter: events sent by this line (global var oe_dbg_n_y7).
oe_y7_count = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y7 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_y7 value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_y7 add = 1 }
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_y7_add_bonus = { amount = N }: the event pool of the momentum target, -20..20.
oe_y7_add_bonus = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_bonus } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bonus value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bonus add = $amount$ }
    clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bonus min = -20 max = 20 }
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_y7_add_court = { amount = N }: court opinion 0-100.
oe_y7_add_court = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_court } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_court add = $amount$ } clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_court min = 0 max = 100 } }
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_y7_unit_loyalty = { unit = U amount = N }: a Y3 branch secretariat's loyalty (Y3 numbering: 2 Henan
# Jiangbei, 3 Jiangzhe, 5 Huguang). Nothing when Y3 is not in this mod.
oe_y7_unit_loyalty = {
    oe_yp_change_loyalty = { unit = $unit$ amount = $amount$ }
}

# Any scope. Needs scope:oe_y7_aim (a location). Saves scope:oe_y7_at: the aim when the Yuan owns and controls it, else the
# Yuan's controlled location nearest to it; nothing when the Yuan holds no land.
oe_y7_find_spot = {
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } clear_saved_scope = oe_y7_at }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_y7_aim = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI } } scope:oe_y7_aim = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_at } }
    else = {
        c:CHI ?= {
            ordered_owned_location = {
                limit = { controller ?= c:CHI }
                order_by = { value = "distance_to(scope:oe_y7_aim)" multiply = -1 }
                max = 1
                save_scope_as = oe_y7_at
            }
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- modifiers
# Any scope. The counter-modifier with its current size (shares in global var oe_y7_cmd; 0 takes it off).
oe_y7_apply_cmd = {
    c:CHI ?= {
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_court_command } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_court_command }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_y7_cmd ?= 1 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_court_command years = -1 mode = replace size = oe_y7_cmd_size }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_y7_cmd ?= 2 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_court_command years = -1 mode = replace size = oe_y7_cmd_size }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope. Seat modifiers again (after .1 b: size 2) for every prince in the seat.
oe_y7_seats_refresh = {
    if = { limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_1 ?= 1 global_var:oe_y7_ps_1 ?= 3 } } province_definition:yangzhou_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard years = -1 mode = replace size = oe_y7_seat_size } } } }
    if = { limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_2 ?= 1 global_var:oe_y7_ps_2 ?= 3 } } province_definition:wuchang_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard years = -1 mode = replace size = oe_y7_seat_size } } } }
    if = { limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_3 ?= 1 global_var:oe_y7_ps_3 ?= 3 } } province_definition:luzhou_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard years = -1 mode = replace size = oe_y7_seat_size } } } }
}
# Any scope. Takes every modifier of this line off the Yuan, its locations, its rival and its characters (not the opinions,
# not the characters themselves).
oe_y7_strip = {
    c:CHI ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_court_command } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_court_command } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_militia } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_militia } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_warlord_army } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_warlord_army } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_general_sway } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_general_sway } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_tammachi_hold } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_tammachi_hold } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_garrison_thin } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_garrison_thin } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_touxia_levy } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_touxia_levy } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_scattered } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_scattered } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_court_rift } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_court_rift } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_restoration } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_restoration } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_despair } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_despair } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_bolod_regime } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_bolod_regime } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_bolod_command } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_bolod_command } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_two_courts } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_two_courts } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_heir_command } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_heir_command } }
    province_definition:yangzhou_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard } }
    province_definition:wuchang_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard } }
    province_definition:luzhou_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard } }
    location:jiangdu = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:shanyang_huaian = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:hefei = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:shangyuan = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:hangzhou = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:jiangxia = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:nanchang = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:xiangyang = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:huaining = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    character:oe_y7_zhennan ?= { if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_zhennan } remove_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_zhennan } }
    character:oe_y7_weishun ?= { if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_weishun } remove_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_weishun } }
    character:oe_y7_xuanrang ?= { if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_xuanrang } remove_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_xuanrang } }
    character:oe_y7_chaghan ?= { if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_chaghan } remove_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_chaghan } }

    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_relief_c country_exists = global_var:oe_y7_relief_c } global_var:oe_y7_relief_c = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_relief } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_relief } } }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- phases
# Any scope. Phase 1 starts: .1 comes the month after (design 3.2).
oe_y7_begin_p1 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_phase value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_militia value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_amnesty value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_amn_ph value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_wait value = 0 }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: phase 1 (the suppression) begins"
}
# Any scope. The militia myriarchies become the generals' armies (phase 2).
oe_y7_to_warlords = {
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_militia ?= 1 }
        c:CHI ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_militia } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_militia } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_warlord_army years = -1 mode = replace } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_militia value = 2 }
    }
}
# Any scope. Phase 2 (the generals): the court's command and the restoration end, the militia become the generals' armies.
oe_y7_to_phase2 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_phase value = 2 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_cmd value = 0 }
    oe_y7_apply_cmd = yes
    c:CHI ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_restoration } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_restoration } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_tammachi_hold } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_tammachi_hold } }
    oe_y7_to_warlords = yes
    # A Bianliang campaign (3) begun in phase 3 goes on: phase 3 can end while it runs.
    if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_y7_camp ?= 3 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp value = 0 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_amn_ph value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_noq } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_noq }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: phase 2 (the generals hold the armies)"
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_y7_to_phase3 = { rest = yes|no }: Toqto'a stays (phase 3): the court's command at one share, the
# restoration modifier when Gaoyou was won.
oe_y7_to_phase3 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_phase value = 3 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_toqto value = 3 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_cmd value = 1 }
    oe_y7_apply_cmd = yes
    if = { limit = { always = $rest$ } c:CHI ?= { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_restoration years = -1 mode = replace } } }
    c:CHI ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_tammachi_hold } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_tammachi_hold } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_amn_ph value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_noq } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_noq }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: phase 3 (Toqto'a stays)"
}
# Any scope, monthly. Phase changes by date and state (design 3.2).
oe_y7_phase_step = {
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_phase = 0 has_global_variable = oe_y7_s global_var:oe_y7_m >= global_var:oe_y7_s }
        oe_y7_begin_p1 = yes
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_phase = 1 }
        # Gaoyou without an edict (no Toqto'a at .11, or the edict dropped): the campaign's end starts phase 2.
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_y7_camp ?= 2 has_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done global_var:oe_y7_noq ?= 1 }
            debug_log = "oe_y7: the Gaoyou campaign ended without an edict"
            oe_y7_to_phase2 = yes
        }
        # The latest end of phase 1 (S+57), unless the Gaoyou campaign still runs or waits for its edict or outcome.
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_y7_m >= oe_y7_p1_last NOT = { global_var:oe_y7_camp ?= 2 } NOT = { oe_y7_due_12 = yes } }
            oe_y7_to_phase2 = yes
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_phase = 3 }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { character:yua_toqto ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_toqto value = 4 }
            oe_y7_to_phase2 = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_y7_toqto_in_charge = no }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_toqto value = 2 }
            oe_y7_to_phase2 = yes
        }
        else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1362.1.1 } oe_y7_to_phase2 = yes }
    }
    # Toqto'a dead while dismissed (.15 or otherwise).
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_toqto ?= 2 NOT = { character:yua_toqto ?= { is_alive = yes } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_toqto value = 4 } }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- meters (design 3.3)
# Any scope, each quarter from .1. The slow part of the target: share of the Middle Kingdom, Red Turban members, war.
oe_y7_quarter = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_share value = oe_y7_share_band }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_rebels value = 0 }
    international_organization:red_turban_rebels ?= { every_international_organization_member = { change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_rebels add = 1 } } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_t0 value = oe_y7_t0_value }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_shi >= 70 }
        every_country = { limit = { oe_y7_warlord = yes oe_y7_aligned = no } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_y7_bias_awe target = c:CHI } }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: momentum high, the warlords are awed"
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_shi < 30 } c:CHI ?= { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_despair months = 3 mode = replace } } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_qnext value = global_var:oe_y7_m }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_qnext add = 3 }
}
# Any scope, monthly after .1. Momentum moves at most 3 toward the target; the pool returns to 0; court opinion drifts
# while Toqto'a is in charge (phases 1 and 3).
oe_y7_meters = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_qnext global_var:oe_y7_m >= global_var:oe_y7_qnext } oe_y7_quarter = yes }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_bonus > 0 } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bonus add = -1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_bonus < 0 } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bonus add = 1 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_t value = oe_y7_t_value }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_shi < global_var:oe_y7_t }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_shi add = 3 }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_shi > global_var:oe_y7_t } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_shi value = global_var:oe_y7_t } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_shi > global_var:oe_y7_t }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_shi add = -3 }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_shi < global_var:oe_y7_t } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_shi value = global_var:oe_y7_t } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_phase = 1 global_var:oe_y7_phase = 3 } oe_y7_toqto_in_charge = yes }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_shi >= 65 } oe_y7_add_court = { amount = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_frozen } }
            if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_shi <= 35 } oe_y7_add_court = { amount = -1 } }
            if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { gold < 0 } } oe_y7_add_court = { amount = -1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_cnext global_var:oe_y7_m >= global_var:oe_y7_cnext }
                oe_y7_add_court = { amount = -1 }
                change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_cnext add = global_var:oe_y7_cstep }
            }
        }
    }
    c:CHI ?= { set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_levy value = country_total_army_levy_size } }
}
# Any scope, monthly after .1. The seats: a prince dead or gone (status 4), lost months, held months.
oe_y7_seats = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_1 = 1 global_var:oe_y7_ps_1 = 2 global_var:oe_y7_ps_1 = 3 global_var:oe_y7_ps_1 = 5 } NOT = { character:oe_y7_zhennan ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI } } }
        if = { limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_1 = 1 global_var:oe_y7_ps_1 = 3 } } province_definition:yangzhou_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ps_1 value = 4 }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: prince 1 dead or no longer at the Yuan court (status 4)"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_1 = 1 global_var:oe_y7_ps_1 = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { location:jiangdu = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pl_1 value = 0 } }
        else = { change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pl_1 add = 1 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_1 = 2 }
        if = { limit = { location:jiangdu = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ph_1 add = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ph_1 value = 0 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_2 = 1 global_var:oe_y7_ps_2 = 2 global_var:oe_y7_ps_2 = 3 global_var:oe_y7_ps_2 = 5 } NOT = { character:oe_y7_weishun ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI } } }
        if = { limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_2 = 1 global_var:oe_y7_ps_2 = 3 } } province_definition:wuchang_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ps_2 value = 4 }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: prince 2 dead or no longer at the Yuan court (status 4)"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_2 = 1 global_var:oe_y7_ps_2 = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { location:jiangxia = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pl_2 value = 0 } }
        else = { change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pl_2 add = 1 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_2 = 2 }
        if = { limit = { location:jiangxia = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ph_2 add = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ph_2 value = 0 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_3 = 1 global_var:oe_y7_ps_3 = 2 global_var:oe_y7_ps_3 = 3 global_var:oe_y7_ps_3 = 5 } NOT = { character:oe_y7_xuanrang ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI } } }
        if = { limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_3 = 1 global_var:oe_y7_ps_3 = 3 } } province_definition:luzhou_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ps_3 value = 4 }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: prince 3 dead or no longer at the Yuan court (status 4)"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_3 = 1 global_var:oe_y7_ps_3 = 3 } }
        if = { limit = { location:hefei = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pl_3 value = 0 } }
        else = { change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pl_3 add = 1 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_ps_3 = 2 }
        if = { limit = { location:hefei = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI } } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ph_3 add = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ph_3 value = 0 } }
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly after .1. The nine garrisons end with their city or in 1360.1.1.
oe_y7_garrisons = {
    location:jiangdu = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison OR = { NOT = { owner ?= c:CHI } current_date >= 1360.1.1 } } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:shanyang_huaian = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison OR = { NOT = { owner ?= c:CHI } current_date >= 1360.1.1 } } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:hefei = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison OR = { NOT = { owner ?= c:CHI } current_date >= 1360.1.1 } } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:shangyuan = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison OR = { NOT = { owner ?= c:CHI } current_date >= 1360.1.1 } } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:hangzhou = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison OR = { NOT = { owner ?= c:CHI } current_date >= 1360.1.1 } } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:jiangxia = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison OR = { NOT = { owner ?= c:CHI } current_date >= 1360.1.1 } } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:nanchang = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison OR = { NOT = { owner ?= c:CHI } current_date >= 1360.1.1 } } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:xiangyang = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison OR = { NOT = { owner ?= c:CHI } current_date >= 1360.1.1 } } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
    location:huaining = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison OR = { NOT = { owner ?= c:CHI } current_date >= 1360.1.1 } } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_garrison } }
}
# Any scope, monthly. A campaign succeeds when the Yuan controls its target (Gaoyou also when the enemy is gone or has come
# over; Bianliang also when a loyal warlord controls it); it fails at its deadline (global var oe_y7_campend).
oe_y7_campaign = {
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_camp ?= 1 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done } }
        if = { limit = { location:xuzhou = { controller ?= c:CHI } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp_ok value = 1 } set_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done debug_log = "oe_y7: Xuzhou campaign won" }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_m >= global_var:oe_y7_campend } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp_ok value = 0 } set_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done debug_log = "oe_y7: Xuzhou campaign failed" }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_camp ?= 2 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done } }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    global_var:oe_y7_tgt ?= { controller ?= c:CHI }
                    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_opp2 }
                    AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_opp2 NOT = { country_exists = global_var:oe_y7_opp2 } }
                    AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_opp2 country_exists = global_var:oe_y7_opp2 global_var:oe_y7_opp2 = { oe_y7_aligned = yes } }
                }
            }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp_ok value = 1 } set_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done debug_log = "oe_y7: Gaoyou campaign won"
        }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_m >= global_var:oe_y7_campend } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp_ok value = 0 } set_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done debug_log = "oe_y7: Gaoyou campaign failed" }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_camp ?= 3 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done } }
        if = { limit = { location:kaifeng = { OR = { controller ?= c:CHI controller ?= { oe_y7_warlord = yes oe_y7_aligned = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:CHI } } } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp_ok value = 1 } set_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done debug_log = "oe_y7: Bianliang campaign won" }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_m >= global_var:oe_y7_campend } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp_ok value = 0 } set_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done debug_log = "oe_y7: Bianliang campaign failed" }
    }
    # third batch: campaign 4 "守大都" (after .31 b): lost when the city fell; at its deadline won if the Yuan holds Dadu and
    # the capital is no longer pressed, else 3 months more (design 3.8).
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_camp ?= 4 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done } }
        if = { limit = { oe_y7_dadu_fallen = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp_ok value = 0 } set_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done debug_log = "oe_y7: the defence of Dadu failed (the city fell)" }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_y7_m >= global_var:oe_y7_campend }
            if = { limit = { oe_y7_dadu_capital = yes oe_y7_dadu_pressed = no } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp_ok value = 1 } set_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done debug_log = "oe_y7: Dadu held (campaign 4 won)" }
            else = { change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_campend add = 3 } debug_log = "oe_y7: Dadu still pressed; campaign 4 goes on" }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_y7_start_camp = { n = 1|2|3 }: a campaign with a 6-month deadline (3, Bianliang: its job adds 2).
oe_y7_start_camp = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp value = $n$ }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp_ok value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_campend value = global_var:oe_y7_m }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_campend add = 6 }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: a campaign begins (oe_y7_camp 1 Xuzhou, 2 Gaoyou, 3 Bianliang)"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the end (design 3.8)
# Any scope. Usage: oe_y7_finish = { code = N }: the line ends: every modifier off, phase 4, global var oe_y7_end = N, the
# line off. Characters stay.
oe_y7_finish = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_on }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_end value = $code$ }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_phase value = 4 }
        oe_y7_strip = yes
        remove_global_variable = oe_y7_on
        debug_log = "oe_y7: the line ends (code in oe_y7_end)"
    }
}
# Any scope (F6's COLLAPSE_HOOKS; also this line's own monthly check). The Yuan has fallen: the line ends with code 4.
oe_y7_on_yuan_fall = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_on } oe_y7_finish = { code = 4 } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_epi } oe_y7_epi_close = { code = 2 } }
}
# Any scope, monthly. The end checks: collapse (4), the situation over (1-3), 1368.1.1 (5).
oe_y7_end_check = {
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_yuan_fallen = yes } oe_y7_on_yuan_fall = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_phase >= 1 oe_y7_rtr_ended = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_tmp value = oe_y7_rtr_code }
        oe_y7_finish = { code = global_var:oe_y7_tmp }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_tmp } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_tmp }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1368.1.1 } oe_y7_epi_open = yes oe_y7_finish = { code = 5 } }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- setup
# Any scope. The first run in a game: before 1358.1.1 and with a Mongol Yuan the line waits for the situation (phase 0).
oe_y7_setup = {
    set_global_variable = oe_y7_init
    if = {
        limit = { current_date < 1358.1.1 oe_y7_yuan_ok = yes }
        set_global_variable = oe_y7_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_phase value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_toqto value = 0 }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: the line waits for the Red Turbans (phase 0)"
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { current_date >= 1358.1.1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_end value = 8 }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: too late, the line stays off (code 8)"
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_end value = 4 }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: no Mongol Yuan, the line stays off (code 4)"
    }
}
# Any scope, phase 0. The situation seen running: S is next month; from 1358.1.1 the line never opens (code 8).
oe_y7_standby = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_y7_rtr_active = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_s } }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1358.1.1 } oe_y7_finish = { code = 8 } }
        else = {
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_s value = global_var:oe_y7_m }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_s add = 1 }
            debug_log = "oe_y7: the Red Turban situation is running; phase 1 next month"
        }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_s } current_date >= 1358.1.1 } oe_y7_finish = { code = 8 } }
}
# CHI scope (.1's immediate). Once: Han Shantong out of prison (decision 184: the vanilla Song can rise), the three princes
# (created if missing; a prince whose seat the Yuan holds musters the guard there and gets the seat modifier), the nine
# garrisons.
oe_y7_setup_p1 = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_p1_done } }
        set_global_variable = oe_y7_p1_done
        character:cso_shantong_han ?= {
            if = {
                limit = { is_alive = yes has_character_modifier = imprisoned }
                remove_character_modifier = imprisoned
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_han_freed value = 1 }
                debug_log = "oe_y7: Han Shantong let out of prison (the Song can rise)"
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { exists = character:oe_y7_zhennan } }
            if = { limit = { current_date >= 1334.1.1 } create_character = { first_name = oe_y7_name_1 dynasty = dynasty:borjigin_dynasty culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no birth_date = 1318.1.1 adm = 45 dip = 50 mil = 60 script = oe_y7_zhennan } }
            else = { create_character = { first_name = oe_y7_name_1 dynasty = dynasty:borjigin_dynasty culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no age = 30 adm = 45 dip = 50 mil = 60 script = oe_y7_zhennan } }
            character:oe_y7_zhennan ?= { add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_title_zhennan years = -1 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y7_who value = 1 } }
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = character:oe_y7_zhennan } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_c_1 value = character:oe_y7_zhennan } }
        if = {
            limit = { location:jiangdu = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI } character:oe_y7_zhennan ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ps_1 value = 1 }
            province_definition:yangzhou_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard years = -1 mode = replace size = oe_y7_seat_size } } }
            location:jiangdu = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes random_unit_in_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI is_navy = no has_commander = no } set_as_commander = character:oe_y7_zhennan } } debug_log = "oe_y7: 4 regiments (p1) raised for the Yuan" }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ps_1 value = 2 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pl_1 value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ph_1 value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { exists = character:oe_y7_weishun } }
            if = { limit = { current_date >= 1316.1.1 } create_character = { first_name = oe_y7_name_2 dynasty = dynasty:borjigin_dynasty culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no birth_date = 1300.1.1 adm = 40 dip = 45 mil = 45 script = oe_y7_weishun } }
            else = { create_character = { first_name = oe_y7_name_2 dynasty = dynasty:borjigin_dynasty culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no age = 30 adm = 40 dip = 45 mil = 45 script = oe_y7_weishun } }
            character:oe_y7_weishun ?= { add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_title_weishun years = -1 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y7_who value = 2 } }
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = character:oe_y7_weishun } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_c_2 value = character:oe_y7_weishun } }
        if = {
            limit = { location:jiangxia = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI } character:oe_y7_weishun ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ps_2 value = 1 }
            province_definition:wuchang_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard years = -1 mode = replace size = oe_y7_seat_size } } }
            location:jiangxia = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes random_unit_in_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI is_navy = no has_commander = no } set_as_commander = character:oe_y7_weishun } } debug_log = "oe_y7: 4 regiments (p2) raised for the Yuan" }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ps_2 value = 2 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pl_2 value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ph_2 value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { exists = character:oe_y7_xuanrang } }
            if = { limit = { current_date >= 1301.1.1 } create_character = { first_name = oe_y7_name_3 dynasty = dynasty:borjigin_dynasty culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no birth_date = 1285.1.1 adm = 50 dip = 55 mil = 50 script = oe_y7_xuanrang } }
            else = { create_character = { first_name = oe_y7_name_3 dynasty = dynasty:borjigin_dynasty culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no age = 30 adm = 50 dip = 55 mil = 50 script = oe_y7_xuanrang } }
            character:oe_y7_xuanrang ?= { add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_title_xuanrang years = -1 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y7_who value = 3 } }
        }
        if = { limit = { exists = character:oe_y7_xuanrang } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_c_3 value = character:oe_y7_xuanrang } }
        if = {
            limit = { location:hefei = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI } character:oe_y7_xuanrang ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ps_3 value = 1 }
            province_definition:luzhou_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard years = -1 mode = replace size = oe_y7_seat_size } } }
            location:hefei = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes random_unit_in_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI is_navy = no has_commander = no } set_as_commander = character:oe_y7_xuanrang } } debug_log = "oe_y7: 3 regiments (p3) raised for the Yuan" }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ps_3 value = 2 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pl_3 value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ph_3 value = 0 }
        location:jiangdu = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_garrison years = -1 mode = replace } } }
        location:shanyang_huaian = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_garrison years = -1 mode = replace } } }
        location:hefei = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_garrison years = -1 mode = replace } } }
        location:shangyuan = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_garrison years = -1 mode = replace } } }
        location:hangzhou = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_garrison years = -1 mode = replace } } }
        location:jiangxia = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_garrison years = -1 mode = replace } } }
        location:nanchang = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_garrison years = -1 mode = replace } } }
        location:xiangyang = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_garrison years = -1 mode = replace } } }

oe_y7_ev_lapse = {
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_lapse_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_2 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y7: event oe_y7.2 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_lapse_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_3 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y7: event oe_y7.3 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_lapse_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_4 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y7: event oe_y7.4 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_lapse_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_5 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y7: event oe_y7.5 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_lapse_10 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_10 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y7: event oe_y7.10 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_lapse_11 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_11 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y7: event oe_y7.11 dropped" }
    # .12 never comes once Toqto'a is out of office: the Gaoyou campaign then ends without an edict (phase 2 after it).
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_12 } has_global_variable = oe_y7_d_12 oe_y7_toqto_in_charge = no } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_12 value = 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_noq value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_y7: event oe_y7.12 dropped (Toqto'a no longer in charge)" }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_15 } global_var:oe_y7_toqto ?= 2 character:yua_toqto ?= { is_alive = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_15 value = 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_toqto value = 4 } }
    # phase 2 (.16, .18): no Chaghan Temür at the Yuan court, or the window is over.
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_lapse_16 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_16 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y7: event oe_y7.16 dropped" }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_lapse_18 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_18 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y7: event oe_y7.18 dropped" }
    # phase 3, first batch (.25): Bolod Temür no longer at Datong, or the window is over.
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_lapse_25 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_25 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y7: event oe_y7.25 dropped" }
    # phase 3, second batch (.19): it cannot fire at the end of its window, or the window and its grace are over.
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_lapse_19 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_19 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_y7: event oe_y7.19 dropped" }
}
# Any scope. At most one event a month: a due event first (in the design's order), else one roll per open event. Nothing in a
# month in which another Yuan line already sent the Yuan an event, but a due event waits at most two such months.
oe_y7_ev_pick = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_wait } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_wait value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_y7_yuan_busy = no global_var:oe_y7_wait >= 2 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_31 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 31 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_32 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 32 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_12 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 12 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_13 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 13 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_14 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 14 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 6 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_17 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 17 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_7 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 7 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_8 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 8 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_15 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 15 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_26 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 26 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_27 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 27 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_30 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 30 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_28 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 28 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_29 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 29 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 5 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_10 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 10 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_11 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 11 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_16 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 16 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_18 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 18 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_25 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 25 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_19 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 19 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_yuan_busy = no }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_open_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_y7_ch_2 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_open_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_y7_ch_3 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_open_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_y7_ch_4 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 4 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_open_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_y7_ch_5 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 5 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_open_10 = yes } random = { chance = oe_y7_ch_10 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 10 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_open_11 = yes } random = { chance = oe_y7_ch_11 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 11 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_open_16 = yes } random = { chance = oe_y7_ch_16 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 16 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_open_18 = yes } random = { chance = oe_y7_ch_18 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 18 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_open_25 = yes } random = { chance = oe_y7_ch_25 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 25 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_open_19 = yes } random = { chance = oe_y7_ch_19 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 19 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_open_9 = yes } random = { chance = 15 set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 9 } } }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_yuan_busy = yes oe_y7_any_due = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_wait add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 1 } oe_y7_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 2 } oe_y7_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 3 } oe_y7_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 4 } oe_y7_fire_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 5 } oe_y7_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 6 } oe_y7_fire_6 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 7 } oe_y7_fire_7 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 8 } oe_y7_fire_8 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 9 } oe_y7_fire_9 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 10 } oe_y7_fire_10 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 11 } oe_y7_fire_11 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 12 } oe_y7_fire_12 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 13 } oe_y7_fire_13 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 14 } oe_y7_fire_14 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 15 } oe_y7_fire_15 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 16 } oe_y7_fire_16 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 17 } oe_y7_fire_17 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 18 } oe_y7_fire_18 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 25 } oe_y7_fire_25 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 26 } oe_y7_fire_26 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 27 } oe_y7_fire_27 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 19 } oe_y7_fire_19 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 28 } oe_y7_fire_28 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 29 } oe_y7_fire_29 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 30 } oe_y7_fire_30 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 31 } oe_y7_fire_31 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 32 } oe_y7_fire_32 = yes }
}

# BYZ scope (any scope works), monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES id 21 "y7") while
# OR = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_on NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_init } }. The events take no main-line lock.
oe_y7_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_init } } oe_y7_setup = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_on }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_m value = oe_y7_m_now }
        oe_y7_end_check = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_on }
            if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_phase = 0 } oe_y7_standby = yes }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_on } oe_y7_phase_step = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_on global_var:oe_y7_phase >= 1 global_var:oe_y7_phase <= 3 }
                if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_st_1 ?= 1 } oe_y7_meters = yes oe_y7_seats = yes oe_y7_garrisons = yes }
                oe_y7_campaign = yes
                oe_y7_c3_step = yes
                oe_y7_ev_lapse = yes
                oe_y7_ev_pick = yes
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_y1n value = global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 } }
    }
    # phase 3, third batch: the epilogue (from the month after the line closed at 1368.1.1; design 3.8). The scheduler calls this
    # effect in the epilogue only once its LINES row 21 also accepts oe_y7_epi (hook A of y7-sup3c).
    else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_epi } oe_y7_epi_step = yes }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- worker jobs (hidden event oe_y7.20, CHI scope)
# .1 b / c: the seats at two shares.
oe_y7_job_seat2 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_seat2 value = 1 }
    oe_y7_seats_refresh = yes
}
# .2 a: the Tammachi under a new Mongol myriarch, near Bianliang.
oe_y7_job_tammachi = {
    create_character = { culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no age = { 35 50 } mil = { 50 65 } save_scope_as = oe_y7_wanhu }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_wanhu } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_c_5 value = scope:oe_y7_wanhu } }
    location:kaifeng = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes random_unit_in_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI is_navy = no has_commander = no } set_as_commander = scope:oe_y7_wanhu } } debug_log = "oe_y7: 6 regiments (tam) raised for the Yuan" }
}
# .2 c: the Five Touxia (raised as men of the Prince of Lu's land).
oe_y7_job_touxia = {
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_origin } clear_saved_scope = oe_y7_origin }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:YLU } c:YLU = { capital ?= { save_scope_as = oe_y7_origin } } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_origin } location:kaifeng = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_hc_o = yes oe_y7_u_hc_o = yes } debug_log = "oe_y7: 2 regiments (tou) raised for the Yuan" } }
    else = { location:kaifeng = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_hc = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes } debug_log = "oe_y7: 2 regiments (tou) raised for the Yuan" } }
}
# .4 a: Chaghan Temür (created if missing) and the militia near Shenqiu.
oe_y7_job_militia = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = character:oe_y7_chaghan } }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1341.1.1 } create_character = { first_name = oe_y7_name_4 culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no birth_date = 1325.1.1 adm = 60 dip = 55 mil = 80 script = oe_y7_chaghan } }
        else = { create_character = { first_name = oe_y7_name_4 culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no age = 30 adm = 60 dip = 55 mil = 80 script = oe_y7_chaghan } }
        character:oe_y7_chaghan ?= { add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_title_chaghan years = -1 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y7_who value = 4 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = character:oe_y7_chaghan } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_c_4 value = character:oe_y7_chaghan } }
    location:shenqiu = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes random_unit_in_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI is_navy = no has_commander = no } set_as_commander = character:oe_y7_chaghan } } debug_log = "oe_y7: 6 regiments (mil) raised for the Yuan" }
}
# .5: the Xuzhou campaign (a: the chancellor in person, b: generals).
oe_y7_job_xuzhou_a = {
    oe_y7_start_camp = { n = 1 }
    location:xuzhou = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_hi = yes oe_y7_u_hi = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes } debug_log = "oe_y7: 10 regiments (xa) raised for the Yuan" }
}
oe_y7_job_xuzhou_b = {
    oe_y7_start_camp = { n = 1 }
    location:xuzhou = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes } debug_log = "oe_y7: 6 regiments (xb) raised for the Yuan" }
}
# .6 a / b (Xuzhou taken): war score against the city's defender, Henan Jiangbei's loyalty; a: the massacre.
oe_y7_job_xuzhou_won = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_opp1 country_exists = global_var:oe_y7_opp1 } global_var:oe_y7_opp1 = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_o } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_o } c:CHI = { "war_with_country(scope:oe_y7_o)" ?= { add_bonus_warscore = { country = c:CHI amount = 15 } } } }
    oe_y7_unit_loyalty = { unit = 2 amount = 5 }
}
oe_y7_job_massacre = {
    location:xuzhou = { every_pop = { add_pop_size = { value = pop_size multiply = -0.2 } } }
    every_country = { limit = { oe_y7_warlord = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_y7_bias_terror target = c:CHI } }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: Xuzhou put to the sword"
}
# .9 a: amnesty for the warlord in global var oe_y7_amn_c: allegiance +60, opinion, white peace.
oe_y7_job_amnesty = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_amn_c country_exists = global_var:oe_y7_amn_c } global_var:oe_y7_amn_c = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_o } }
    scope:oe_y7_o ?= {
        rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 60 }
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_y7_bias_amnesty target = c:CHI }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_o } oe_y7_peace = yes change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_amnesty add = 1 } }
}
# Any scope. Needs scope:oe_y7_o: white peace in the Yuan's war with it.
oe_y7_peace = {
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_war } clear_saved_scope = oe_y7_war }
    c:CHI ?= { "war_with_country(scope:oe_y7_o)" ?= { save_scope_as = oe_y7_war } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_war } c:CHI = { white_peace = scope:oe_y7_war } }
}
# .11 a / c: the Gaoyou campaign (a with the chancellor: the princes asked for men, Korean riders while Goryeo carries the
# Zhengdong marker).
oe_y7_job_gaoyou = {
    oe_y7_start_camp = { n = 2 }
    global_var:oe_y7_tgt ?= { save_scope_as = oe_y7_gy }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_gy }
        scope:oe_y7_gy = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_hi = yes oe_y7_u_hi = yes oe_y7_u_hi = yes oe_y7_u_hi = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes } debug_log = "oe_y7: 18 regiments (ga) raised for the Yuan" }
        if = { limit = { oe_y1_zd_active = yes country_exists = c:KOR } if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_origin } clear_saved_scope = oe_y7_origin } c:KOR = { capital ?= { save_scope_as = oe_y7_origin } } scope:oe_y7_gy = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_lc_o = yes oe_y7_u_lc_o = yes } debug_log = "oe_y7: 2 regiments (kor) raised for the Yuan" } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_kor_gaoyou value = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_toqto_in_charge = yes } oe_yw_ask_aid = { kind = 2 } }
}
# .11 b: hold back; the court's command at one share, the edict at S+48.
oe_y7_job_slow = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_cmd value = 1 }
    oe_y7_apply_cmd = yes
}
# .12 a and .13's roll: the dismissal (design: the worker's job 1).
oe_y7_job_dismiss = {
    character:yua_toqto ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { is_alive = yes }
            remove_head_of_cabinet_effect = yes
            add_character_modifier = { modifier = permanently_banned_from_cabinet days = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
            save_scope_as = oe_y7_toqto_gone
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_toqto_gone scope:oe_y7_toqto_gone = { in_cabinet = yes } } remove_from_cabinet = scope:oe_y7_toqto_gone }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = yua_dictator_powers } remove_country_modifier = yua_dictator_powers }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_scattered months = 12 mode = replace }
    every_unit = { limit = { is_navy = no } damage_unit_percent = 0.3 damage_unit_morale_percent = 0.5 }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_opp2 country_exists = global_var:oe_y7_opp2 }
        global_var:oe_y7_opp2 = {
            save_scope_as = oe_y7_o
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_relief months = 60 mode = replace }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_relief_c value = scope:oe_y7_o }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_o } "war_with_country(scope:oe_y7_o)" ?= { add_bonus_warscore = { country = scope:oe_y7_o amount = 20 } } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_shi > 35 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_shi value = 35 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_toqto value = 2 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_death_m value = global_var:oe_y7_m }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_death_m add = 12 }
    oe_y7_unit_loyalty = { unit = 2 amount = -5 }
    oe_y7_unit_loyalty = { unit = 3 amount = -5 }
    oe_y7_to_phase2 = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_14 value = global_var:oe_y7_m }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_14 add = 1 }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: Toqto'a dismissed; the army scatters"
}
# .12 b: Toqto'a kept against the court; the campaign gets 4 more months (no campaign: phase 3 at once).
oe_y7_job_keep = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_keep value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_court value = 55 }
    set_global_variable = oe_y7_frozen
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_court_rift months = 60 mode = replace }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_camp ?= 2 }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_campend add = 4 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done global_var:oe_y7_camp_ok ?= 0 } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done }
    }
    else = { oe_y7_to_phase3 = { rest = no } }
}
# .13 a / b (Gaoyou won): take the land or pardon; then phase 3 with the restoration.
oe_y7_job_gaoyou_take = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_opp2 country_exists = global_var:oe_y7_opp2 } global_var:oe_y7_opp2 = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_o } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_o scope:oe_y7_o = { num_locations <= 15 } }
        annex_country = { country = scope:oe_y7_o }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: the Gaoyou enemy annexed"
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_o }
        "war_with_country(scope:oe_y7_o)" ?= { add_bonus_warscore = { country = c:CHI amount = 40 } }
        scope:oe_y7_o = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 50 } }
    }
    oe_y7_gaoyou_won = yes
}
oe_y7_job_gaoyou_pardon = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_opp2 country_exists = global_var:oe_y7_opp2 } global_var:oe_y7_opp2 = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_o } }
    scope:oe_y7_o ?= {
        rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 100 }
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_y7_bias_submit target = c:CHI }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_o } oe_y7_peace = yes }
    oe_y7_gaoyou_won = yes
}
oe_y7_gaoyou_won = {
    oe_y7_add_bonus = { amount = 15 }
    oe_y7_add_court = { amount = 10 }
    oe_y7_unit_loyalty = { unit = 2 amount = 8 }
    oe_y7_to_phase3 = { rest = yes }
}
# .13 c (Gaoyou not taken in the longer time): the debate again; the edict with the dismissal weight (+20).
oe_y7_job_reroll = {
    set_global_variable = oe_y7_reroll
    random = {
        chance = oe_y7_dismiss_w
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_tmp value = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_tmp ?= 1 } oe_y7_job_dismiss = yes }
    else = { oe_y7_to_phase3 = { rest = no } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_tmp } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_tmp }
}
# .7 a: the prince's command taken.
oe_y7_job_seal = {
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_seat_n ?= 1 } character:oe_y7_zhennan ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } remove_commander = this } } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_seat_n ?= 2 } character:oe_y7_weishun ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } remove_commander = this } } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_seat_n ?= 3 } character:oe_y7_xuanrang ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } remove_commander = this } } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_seat_n } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_seat_n }
}
# .8 a: the prince back at the seat: seat modifier, status 3, a Yuan army there without a commander gets the prince.
oe_y7_job_return = {
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_seat_n ?= 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ps_1 value = 3 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pl_1 value = 0 }
        province_definition:yangzhou_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard years = -1 mode = replace size = oe_y7_seat_size } } }
        location:jiangdu = { random_unit_in_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI is_navy = no has_commander = no } set_as_commander = character:oe_y7_zhennan } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_seat_n ?= 2 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ps_2 value = 3 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pl_2 value = 0 }
        province_definition:wuchang_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard years = -1 mode = replace size = oe_y7_seat_size } } }
        location:jiangxia = { random_unit_in_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI is_navy = no has_commander = no } set_as_commander = character:oe_y7_weishun } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_seat_n ?= 3 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_ps_3 value = 3 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pl_3 value = 0 }
        province_definition:luzhou_province = { every_location_in_province_definition = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_seat_guard years = -1 mode = replace size = oe_y7_seat_size } } }
        location:hefei = { random_unit_in_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI is_navy = no has_commander = no } set_as_commander = character:oe_y7_xuanrang } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_seat_n } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_seat_n }
}
# .16 a: the Bianliang campaign (8 months), mustered near Bianliang under Chaghan Temür (without a commander if the
# general died or left the Yuan court between the event and the answer).
oe_y7_job_bianliang = {
    oe_y7_start_camp = { n = 3 }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_campend add = 2 }
    if = { limit = { character:oe_y7_chaghan ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI } } location:kaifeng = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes random_unit_in_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI is_navy = no has_commander = no } set_as_commander = character:oe_y7_chaghan } } debug_log = "oe_y7: 8 regiments (bl) raised for the Yuan" } }
    else = { location:kaifeng = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes } debug_log = "oe_y7: 8 regiments (bl) raised for the Yuan" } }
}

    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_fall } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_fall }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_epi } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_epi }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_epi_end } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_epi_end }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_t_press } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_t_press }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_t_fall } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_t_fall }
    c:CHI ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y7_job } remove_variable = oe_y7_job } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y7_dw } remove_variable = oe_y7_dw } }
    c:CHI ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_y7_win26 } remove_variable = oe_y7_win26 } }
}

    oe_y7_test_clear = yes
    oe_y7_setup = yes
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_on }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_m value = oe_y7_m_now }

    }
    debug_log = "oe_y7 TEST: line restarted"
}

    oe_y7_monthly = yes
}

# TEST ONLY (button y7beaten; yuan-fix1). A Red Turban member at war with the Yuan counts as beaten the way .9 reads it
# (oe_y7_amn_ok: the Yuan controls a quarter of its land): the Yuan takes control of all its locations but its capital (the
# capital too when that is not enough). The occupation is real and is not undone. Nothing calls this in a normal game.
oe_y7_test_beaten = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_y7_amn_any = yes }
        debug_log = "oe_y7 TEST: a Red Turban member already counts as beaten (press y7fire9)"
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI international_organization:red_turban_rebels ?= { any_international_organization_member = { is_at_war_with = c:CHI } } }
        international_organization:red_turban_rebels = {
            random_international_organization_member = {
                limit = { is_at_war_with = c:CHI }
                every_owned_location = { limit = { is_capital = no } change_location_controller = c:CHI }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_y7_amn_ok = yes } } every_owned_location = { change_location_controller = c:CHI } }
            }
        }
        debug_log = "oe_y7 TEST: the Yuan now controls a Red Turban member's land (press y7fire9)"
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_y7 TEST: no Red Turban member is at war with the Yuan (y7rtr, y7start, y7month first)" }
}
