# Usage: oe_y7_test_bl = { ok = 1|0 }: the Bianliang campaign counts as decided now (1 won, 0 lost) and its outcome event
# (.17) goes to the Yuan.
oe_y7_test_bl = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_m value = oe_y7_m_now } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp value = 3 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp_ok value = $ok$ }
    set_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_17 } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_st_17 }
    oe_y7_fire_17 = yes
}
# Switches the line off and clears it (the next scheduler round finds it initialised and leaves it off).
oe_y7_test_reset = {
    oe_y7_test_clear = yes
    set_global_variable = oe_y7_init
    debug_log = "oe_y7 TEST: line reset and off"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- phase 3, first batch "孛罗之乱" (v6.6 y7-sup3a)
# CHI scope. The ONLY place Bolod Temür is made (brief B7: one effect, so a later change of the form touches one place).
# Every read of the character elsewhere is behind ?= or exists = character:oe_y7_bolod.
oe_y7_make_bolod = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = character:oe_y7_bolod } }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1344.1.1 } create_character = { first_name = oe_y7_name_6 culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no birth_date = 1328.1.1 adm = 45 dip = 35 mil = 75 script = oe_y7_bolod } }
        else = { create_character = { first_name = oe_y7_name_6 culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no age = 30 adm = 45 dip = 35 mil = 75 script = oe_y7_bolod } }
        character:oe_y7_bolod ?= { add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_title_bolod years = -1 mode = replace } set_variable = { name = oe_y7_who value = 6 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = character:oe_y7_bolod } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_c_6 value = character:oe_y7_bolod } }
}
# Any scope. The first batch is void from here on: every one of .25-.27 still pending is dropped.
oe_y7_void_b1 = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_25 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_25 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_26 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_26 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_27 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_27 value = 2 } }
}
# CHI scope. World step W-1 (design 3.6): Bolod Temür at Datong with 4 regiments under Bolod Temür; no popup, no
# oe_yuan_ev_m. oe_y7_bolod 9 when the character cannot be made or read back (the first batch is then void).
oe_y7_w1_fx = {
    oe_y7_make_bolod = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_w1_m value = global_var:oe_y7_m }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_y7_bolod_ok = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bolod value = 1 }
        location:datong_datong = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_lc = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes random_unit_in_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI is_navy = no has_commander = no } set_as_commander = character:oe_y7_bolod } } debug_log = "oe_y7: 4 regiments (bolod) raised for the Yuan" }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: W-1 Bolod Temür at Datong (oe_y7_bolod 1)"
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bolod value = 9 }
        oe_y7_void_b1 = yes
        debug_log = "oe_y7: W-1 could not make or read back Bolod Temür (oe_y7_bolod 9); the first batch is void"
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly until W-1 has happened. Its window opens the first month its conditions hold; it is rolled
# 100 / months left and sure at oe_y7_w1_hi; from month 345 (1366.1) without it the first batch is void.
oe_y7_w1_step = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_y7_w1_can = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_w1_open } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_w1_open value = global_var:oe_y7_m }
            debug_log = "oe_y7: W-1 window open"
        }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_m >= oe_y7_w1_hi } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_tmp value = 1 } }
        else = { random = { chance = oe_y7_w1_ch set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_tmp value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_tmp ?= 1 } c:CHI ?= { oe_y7_w1_fx = yes } }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_tmp } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_tmp }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_m >= 345 }
        oe_y7_void_b1 = yes
        debug_log = "oe_y7: W-1 never came; the first batch is void"
    }
}
# Any scope. Bolod Temür has died or is no longer at the Yuan court, or no longer heads the cabinet while in power (3, 7):
# the line's modifiers on Bolod Temür's rule go, vanilla's dictator modifier too when Bolod Temür held it and Toqto'a is
# not in charge; state 4 (dead) or 5 (gone); from state 3 the second batch's .28 is still scheduled.
oe_y7_bolod_gone = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 3 global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 7 } }
        c:CHI ?= { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_bolod_regime } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_bolod_regime } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_bolod_command } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_bolod_command } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_bolod_nohead } has_country_modifier = yua_dictator_powers oe_y7_toqto_in_charge = no } remove_country_modifier = yua_dictator_powers } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 3 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_28 value = global_var:oe_y7_m } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_28 add = 3 } }
    }
    oe_y7_void_b1 = yes
    if = {
        limit = { character:oe_y7_bolod ?= { is_alive = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bolod value = 5 }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: Bolod Temür has left the court or the cabinet (oe_y7_bolod 5)"
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bolod value = 4 }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: Bolod Temür is dead (oe_y7_bolod 4)"
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_bolod_nohead } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_bolod_nohead }
}
# Any scope. Bolod Temür stays at Datong for good (24 months after .25 b, or .25 dropped): state 5; .28 scheduled.
oe_y7_bolod_stays = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bolod value = 5 }
    oe_y7_void_b1 = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_28 value = global_var:oe_y7_m }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: Bolod Temür stays at Datong (oe_y7_bolod 5)"
}
# Any scope, monthly in phases 1-3 after the campaigns (design 3.9): the first month seen in phase 2; the one share of
# oe_y7_general_sway that .17 a gave before this check existed; W-1; Bolod Temür dead or gone; .25 b's 24 months.
oe_y7_c3_step = {
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_phase = 2 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_c3_m0 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_c3_m0 value = global_var:oe_y7_m }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: phase 3 checks begin (oe_y7_c3_m0)"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_sway } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_general_sway } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_sway value = 1 }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_bolod } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_25 } } oe_y7_w1_step = yes }
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = { global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 1 global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 2 global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 3 global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 6 global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 7 }
            OR = {
                NOT = { oe_y7_bolod_ok = yes }
                AND = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 3 global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 7 } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_bolod_nohead } NOT = { oe_y7_bolod_head = yes } }
            }
        }
        oe_y7_bolod_gone = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_bolod ?= 1 OR = { global_var:oe_y7_st_25 ?= 2 AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_d25b global_var:oe_y7_m >= oe_y7_d25b_end } } }
        oe_y7_bolod_stays = yes
    }
    oe_y7_c3b_step = yes
    oe_y7_c3c_step = yes
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_y7_sway_add = { n = N }: the shares of oe_y7_general_sway (global var oe_y7_sway) change by N, kept
# in 0-3, and the modifier is applied again (design 3.4; one share counted when .17 a gave it before).
oe_y7_sway_add = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_sway } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_sway value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_general_sway } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_sway value = 1 } }
    }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_sway add = $n$ }
    clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_sway min = 0 max = 3 }
    oe_y7_apply_sway = yes
}
# Any scope. oe_y7_general_sway at its number of shares: none at 0; one share is word for word what .17 a adds.
oe_y7_apply_sway = {
    c:CHI ?= {
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_general_sway } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_general_sway }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_sway ?= 1 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_general_sway years = -1 mode = replace } }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_sway ?= 2 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_general_sway years = -1 mode = replace size = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_sway ?= 3 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_general_sway years = -1 mode = replace size = 3 } }
    }
}
# CHI scope (.26 a; .26 b when the gates fail). Bolod Temür enters the capital (design 3.6, job 22): vanilla's dictator
# effect (into the cabinet as its head; the old head steps down) unless Toqto'a is back in charge (then only this line's
# modifier); Bolod Temür gives up the field command first.
oe_y7_bolod_enter = {
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_b6 } clear_saved_scope = oe_y7_b6 }
    character:oe_y7_bolod ?= { if = { limit = { is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_y7_b6 } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_b6 oe_y7_toqto_in_charge = no }
        scope:oe_y7_b6 = { remove_commander = this }
        # r21 (2026-11-20, seen in game): vanilla's effect only fills an OPEN cabinet seat, and the Yuan's cabinet was
        # full (5 of 5): Bolod Temür was not appointed. So where no seat is open, one member who is not the head
        # leaves the cabinet first (vanilla: remove_from_cabinet, country scope).
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { any_cabinet = { NOT = { exists = cabinet_member } } } }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_seat } clear_saved_scope = oe_y7_seat }
            random_cabinet_character = { limit = { NOT = { has_character_modifier = head_of_the_cabinet_modifier } NOT = { this = scope:oe_y7_b6 } } save_scope_as = oe_y7_seat }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_seat } remove_from_cabinet = scope:oe_y7_seat }
        }
        yua_appoint_as_dictator = { target = scope:oe_y7_b6 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_bolod_nohead } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_bolod_nohead }
        # The self-check: if he still did not get the seat, he rules through this line's modifier only, and the
        # monthly check must not read "not the head" as his leaving.
        if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_y7_bolod_head = yes } } set_global_variable = oe_y7_bolod_nohead }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = oe_y7_bolod_nohead
        debug_log = "oe_y7: Bolod Temür in the capital without the cabinet (Toqto'a in charge)"
    }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_bolod_regime years = -1 mode = replace }
    add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
    add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_penalty
    oe_y7_add_bonus = { amount = -6 }
    oe_y7_sway_add = { n = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes } c:CKO = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = -25 } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_y7_bias_estranged target = c:CHI } } }
    oe_yw_change_loyalty_all = { amount = -2 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bolod value = 3 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_27 value = global_var:oe_y7_m } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_27 add = 12 }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: Bolod Temür enters the capital (oe_y7_bolod 3)"
}
# ---- worker jobs 20-27 (hidden event oe_y7.20, CHI scope)
# .25 a / b: Köke Temür's allegiance.
oe_y7_job_b25a = {
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes } c:CKO = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 10 } } }
}
oe_y7_job_b25b = {
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes } c:CKO = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = -10 } } }
}
# .26 a: the entry.
oe_y7_job_b26a = {
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_bolod_ok = yes } oe_y7_bolod_enter = yes }
}
# .26 b: one roll with the chance fixed when .26 was sent: turned back (state 6), or the entry with more losses.
oe_y7_job_b26b = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_y7_bolod_ok = yes }
        random = { chance = oe_y7_win26_now set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_tmp value = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_y7_tmp ?= 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bolod value = 6 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_27 value = global_var:oe_y7_m } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_27 add = 9 }
            oe_y7_add_bonus = { amount = 4 }
            if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes } c:CKO = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 15 } } }
            debug_log = "oe_y7: the gates held; Bolod Temür beaten back to Datong (oe_y7_bolod 6)"
        }
        else = {
            oe_y7_bolod_enter = yes
            add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
            every_unit = { limit = { is_navy = no } damage_unit_morale_percent = 0.3 }
            debug_log = "oe_y7: the gates did not hold"
        }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_tmp } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_tmp }
    }
}
# .27 a: Bolod Temür killed by the emperor's secret order.
oe_y7_job_b27a = {
    if = { limit = { character:oe_y7_bolod ?= { is_alive = yes } } kill_character_silently = { target = character:oe_y7_bolod } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_bolod_nohead } has_country_modifier = yua_dictator_powers oe_y7_toqto_in_charge = no } remove_country_modifier = yua_dictator_powers }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_y7_bolod_regime } remove_country_modifier = oe_y7_bolod_regime }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bolod value = 4 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_bolod_nohead } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_bolod_nohead }
    oe_y7_sway_add = { n = -1 }
    oe_y7_add_bonus = { amount = 4 }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes } c:CKO = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 30 } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_y7_bias_trusted target = c:CHI } } }
    oe_yw_change_loyalty_all = { amount = 2 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_28 value = global_var:oe_y7_m } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_28 add = 3 }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: Bolod Temür killed (oe_y7_bolod 4)"
}
# .27 b: Bolod Temür kept in power, commanding all the armies; Köke Temür estranged, the second batch void.
oe_y7_job_b27b = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bolod value = 7 }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_bolod_command years = -1 mode = replace }
    oe_y7_sway_add = { n = 1 }
    oe_y7_add_bonus = { amount = -4 }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes } c:CKO = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = -40 } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_y7_bias_estranged target = c:CHI } } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_28 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_28 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_29 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_29 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_30 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_30 value = 2 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_koke value = 5 }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: Bolod Temür kept in power (oe_y7_bolod 7)"
}
# .27 c: spared, the command and the cabinet taken away for good.
oe_y7_job_b27c = {
    character:oe_y7_bolod ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { is_alive = yes }
            remove_commander = this
            add_character_modifier = { modifier = permanently_banned_from_cabinet days = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
        }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_bolod value = 5 }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes } c:CKO = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 10 } } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_28 value = global_var:oe_y7_m } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_d_28 add = 3 }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: Bolod Temür spared and stripped (oe_y7_bolod 5)"
}
# .27 d: Bolod Temür put to death.
oe_y7_job_b27d = {

    debug_log = "oe_y7: Bolod Temür put to death (oe_y7_bolod 4)"
}

    }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- phase 3, second batch "河南王与关中" (v6.6 y7-sup3b)
# Any scope, monthly at the end of oe_y7_c3_step (design 3.7): Köke Temür out of case 甲 and 乙 after .28 (dead, gone from
# the court, CKO gone or at war with the Yuan): state 5, .29 and .30 dropped. .28 come due without Köke Temür in case 甲 or
# 乙: dropped with .29 and .30 (state 5).
oe_y7_c3b_step = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_koke ?= 1 global_var:oe_y7_koke ?= 2 global_var:oe_y7_koke ?= 3 } oe_y7_koke_any = no }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_koke value = 5 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_29 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_29 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_30 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_30 value = 2 } }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: Köke Temür is dead, gone or at war with the Yuan (oe_y7_koke 5)"
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_28 } oe_y7_28_ready = yes oe_y7_koke_any = no }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_28 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_28 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_29 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_29 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_30 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_30 value = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_koke } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_koke value = 5 } }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: event oe_y7.28 dropped (no Köke Temür ruling CKO or at the Yuan court; .29 and .30 with it)"
    }
}
# Any scope. World step W-2 (design 3.7, after .29 a): Köke Temür's CKO and Li Siqi's CSI, both AI, nobody's subjects and
# not at war with each other, get oe_y7_bias_feud towards each other (-100 for 60 months). No war, no casus belli.
# Global var oe_y7_w2: 1 done, 2 not possible.
oe_y7_w2_fx = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_y7_w2_can = yes }
        c:CKO = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_y7_bias_feud target = c:CSI } }
        c:CSI = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_y7_bias_feud target = c:CKO } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_w2 value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: W-2 CKO and CSI at feud (oe_y7_w2 1)"
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_w2 value = 2 }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: W-2 not possible (CKO or CSI gone, a player's, a subject, or at war with each other; oe_y7_w2 2)"
    }
}
# ---- worker jobs 28-35 (hidden event oe_y7.20, CHI scope)
# .28 a: Köke Temür made Prince of Henan: one share more; case 甲 allegiance and trust; case 乙 the title, and a Yuan army
# without a commander at the Yuan's controlled location nearest Bianliang (Kaifeng), if Köke Temür leads none.
oe_y7_job_c28a = {
    oe_y7_sway_add = { n = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes } c:CKO = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 40 } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_y7_bias_trusted target = c:CHI } } }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_y7_koke_court = yes }
        character:cko_temur_koke ?= { add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_title_henan years = -1 mode = replace } }
        location:kaifeng = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim }
        oe_y7_find_spot = yes
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at character:cko_temur_koke ?= { has_unit = no } }
            scope:oe_y7_at = { random_unit_in_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI is_navy = no has_commander = no } set_as_commander = character:cko_temur_koke } }
        }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: Köke Temür made Prince of Henan (oe_y7_koke 2)"
}
# .28 b: the crown prince takes the field; Köke Temür keeps the old office (case 甲 allegiance).
oe_y7_job_c28b = {
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_heir_command years = -1 mode = replace }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes } c:CKO = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = -15 } } }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: the crown prince takes the field; Köke Temür keeps the old office (oe_y7_koke 1)"
}
# .28 c: Köke Temür keeps the old office (case 甲 allegiance).
oe_y7_job_c28c = {
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes } c:CKO = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = -10 } } }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: Köke Temür keeps the old office (oe_y7_koke 1)"
}
# .29 a: Köke Temür sent west against Guanzhong; Li Siqi's allegiance; Shaanxi's loyalty; world step W-2.
oe_y7_job_c29a = {
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes } c:CKO = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 5 } } }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_siqi_lord = yes } c:CSI = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = -25 } } }
    oe_y7_unit_loyalty = { unit = 6 amount = -5 }
    oe_y7_w2_fx = yes
}
# .29 b: the edict of peace, Tongguan the border.

    if = { limit = { oe_y7_siqi_lord = yes } c:CSI = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 10 } } }
    oe_y7_unit_loyalty = { unit = 6 amount = 3 }
}
# .29 c: Li Siqi given the armies of Guanzhong and Shaanxi.
oe_y7_job_c29c = {
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes } c:CKO = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = -30 } } }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_siqi_lord = yes } c:CSI = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 30 } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_y7_bias_trusted target = c:CHI } } }
}
# .30 a: the Grand Regency Office: the crown prince commands, one share less; case 甲 the allegiance left at most 10 and
# estrangement; case 乙 the field command taken (the title stays: "仍前河南王").
oe_y7_job_c30a = {
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_heir_command years = -1 mode = replace }
    oe_y7_sway_add = { n = -1 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes }
        c:CKO = {
            if = { limit = { has_variable = rtr_yuan_allegiance var:rtr_yuan_allegiance > 10 } set_variable = { name = rtr_yuan_allegiance value = 10 } }
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_y7_bias_estranged target = c:CHI }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_court = yes } character:cko_temur_koke ?= { remove_commander = this } }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: Köke Temür dismissed, the Grand Regency Office set up (oe_y7_koke 3)"
}

oe_y7_job_c30b = {
    oe_y7_sway_add = { n = 1 }
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_koke_lord = yes } c:CKO = { rtr_change_allegiance_points = { value = 15 } } }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: Köke Temür kept in command"
}
# ---- TEST ONLY (test page 24, buttons y73*)
# A test Köke Temür at the Yuan court (case 乙) when vanilla has made none: the parameters of vanilla red_turban_rebellions.16
# without its dynasty. Only for a test game: vanilla's .16 later makes Köke Temür with the same script id.
oe_y7_test_koke = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = character:cko_temur_koke } country_exists = c:CHI }
        c:CHI = { create_character = { first_name = name_koke.name_timur culture = culture:mongolian_culture religion = religion:tibetan_buddhism estate = estate_type:nobles_estate female = no birth_date = 1330.1.1 adm = 60 dip = 60 mil = 60 script = cko_temur_koke } }
        debug_log = "oe_y7 TEST: a test Köke Temür made at the Yuan court"
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_y7 TEST: Köke Temür exists already, or no Yuan: nothing made" }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- phase 3, third batch "大都与尾声" (v6.7 y7-sup3c)
# Any scope. World step W-3 (design 3.8): the Prince of Xuanrang is made Prince of Huai (卷47, 二十七年八月辛亥): the title
# changes, global oe_y7_huai 1. No popup, no oe_yuan_ev_m; the prince's status oe_y7_ps_3 keeps its meaning.
oe_y7_w3_fx = {
    character:oe_y7_xuanrang ?= {
        if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_xuanrang } remove_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_xuanrang }
        add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_title_huai years = -1 mode = replace }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_huai value = 1 }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: W-3 the Prince of Xuanrang made Prince of Huai (oe_y7_huai 1)"
}
oe_y7_w3_step = {
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_w3_can = yes } oe_y7_w3_fx = yes }
}
# Any scope. Dadu's two modifiers of this line, the regent's title and campaign 4 "守大都" off.
oe_y7_dadu_clear = {
    location:dadu = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_dadu_stand } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_dadu_stand }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_y7_dadu_left } remove_location_modifier = oe_y7_dadu_left }
    }
    character:oe_y7_xuanrang ?= { if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_regent } remove_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_regent } }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_y7_camp ?= 4 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done }
    }
}
# Any scope (from oe_y7_strip when no epilogue runs, and from the epilogue's end): all of the above and the title of Huai.
oe_y7_strip_dadu = {
    oe_y7_dadu_clear = yes
    character:oe_y7_xuanrang ?= { if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_huai } remove_character_modifier = oe_y7_title_huai } }
}
# Any scope, monthly in phases 2 and 3 and in the epilogue. Before .31: the months in a row the capital is pressed
# (global oe_y7_press; .31 is due at 2). After .31 was answered and before .32: the months in a row Dadu is out of the
# Yuan's control (oe_y7_lost); after .31 a the calm months in a row (oe_y7_calm): at 6 the city counts as relieved, no
# popup (oe_y7_dadu 5, .32 dropped), the regent's title and Dadu's modifier go, and the epilogue ends (code 1).
oe_y7_dadu_step = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_31 } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_y7_dadu_pressed = yes }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_press } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_press value = 0 } }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_press add = 1 }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_press } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_press value = 0 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_32 } OR = { global_var:oe_y7_dadu ?= 1 global_var:oe_y7_dadu ?= 2 } }
        if = { limit = { location:dadu = { controller ?= c:CHI } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_lost value = 0 } }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_lost } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_lost value = 0 } }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_lost add = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_y7_dadu ?= 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_y7_dadu_capital = yes oe_y7_dadu_pressed = no }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_calm } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_calm value = 0 } }
                change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_calm add = 1 }
            }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_calm value = 0 } }
            if = {
                limit = { global_var:oe_y7_calm >= 6 oe_y7_dadu_fallen = no }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_dadu value = 5 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_st_32 value = 2 }
                oe_y7_dadu_clear = yes
                debug_log = "oe_y7: Dadu relieved after the emperor went north (oe_y7_dadu 5, no popup)"
                oe_y7_epi_close = { code = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly in phases 1-3 at the end of oe_y7_c3_step (design 3.9): W-3 in phase 2; the capital in phases 2 and 3.
oe_y7_c3c_step = {
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 2 } oe_y7_w3_step = yes }
    if = { limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 2 global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 3 } } oe_y7_dadu_step = yes }
}

# ---- the epilogue (design 3.8; global oe_y7_epi, end code oe_y7_epi_end)
# Any scope. Called by the 1368.1.1 close just BEFORE oe_y7_finish = { code = 5 } (so that oe_y7_strip keeps Dadu's modifiers
# and the titles of this batch): the epilogue opens while the Yuan stands, is Mongol, owns Dadu and has Dadu as its capital
# (or .31 has come and .32 still waits) and .32 has not come.
oe_y7_epi_open = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_epi }
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_epi_end }
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_32 }
            oe_y7_yuan_ok = yes
            OR = {
                has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_31
                AND = { location:dadu = { owner ?= c:CHI } c:CHI = { capital ?= location:dadu } }
            }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_epi value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: the epilogue begins (Dadu is still the Yuan's capital)"
    }
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_y7_epi_close = { code = N }: the epilogue ends (1 .32 answered or the city relieved, 2 the Yuan fell,
# 3 the situation ended, 4 Dadu lost before .31, 5 1400.1.1, 9 test): everything of this line comes off once more (what a
# .28-.30 of the epilogue added, Dadu's modifiers, the titles of Huai and the regent, campaign 4).
oe_y7_epi_close = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_epi }
        remove_global_variable = oe_y7_epi
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_epi_end value = $code$ }
        oe_y7_strip = yes
        debug_log = "oe_y7: the epilogue ends (code in oe_y7_epi_end)"
    }
}
# Any scope, the epilogue's monthly end checks.
oe_y7_epi_end_check = {
    if = { limit = { oe_y7_yuan_fallen = yes } oe_y7_on_yuan_fall = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_rtr_ended = yes } oe_y7_epi_close = { code = 3 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_st_31 }
            NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:CHI location:dadu = { owner ?= c:CHI } c:CHI = { capital ?= location:dadu } } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_dadu value = 6 }
        debug_log = "oe_y7: Dadu lost before the debate on going north (oe_y7_dadu 6)"
        oe_y7_epi_close = { code = 4 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1400.1.1 } oe_y7_epi_close = { code = 5 } }
}
# Any scope. At most one event a month in the epilogue: .31, .32, or a .28-.30 already scheduled (design 3.8); the same-month
# guard as oe_y7_ev_pick.
oe_y7_epi_pick = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_wait } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_wait value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_y7_yuan_busy = no global_var:oe_y7_wait >= 2 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_31 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 31 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_32 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 32 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_30 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 30 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_28 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 28 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_y7_due_29 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_pick value = 29 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 0 oe_y7_yuan_busy = yes oe_y7_epi_any_due = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_wait add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 31 } oe_y7_fire_31 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 32 } oe_y7_fire_32 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 30 } oe_y7_fire_30 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 28 } oe_y7_fire_28 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_pick = 29 } oe_y7_fire_29 = yes }
}
# Any scope, monthly while the epilogue runs (oe_y7_monthly, once the scheduler calls it then): the end checks, W-3, the
# capital, campaign 4, the events. No meters, no country modifier of the epilogue's own.
oe_y7_epi_step = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_m value = oe_y7_m_now }
    oe_y7_epi_end_check = yes
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_epi }
        oe_y7_w3_step = yes
        oe_y7_dadu_step = yes
        oe_y7_campaign = yes
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_epi } oe_y7_epi_pick = yes }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_y1n value = global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 } }
}
# ---- worker jobs 36-39 (hidden event oe_y7.20, CHI scope)
# .31 a: the emperor goes north. Dadu gets oe_y7_dadu_left (12 months, or until the city falls); the Prince of Huai (or of
# Xuanrang) at the Yuan court is regent and leads a Yuan army at Dadu that has no commander (if he leads none).
oe_y7_job_d31a = {
    location:dadu = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_dadu_left months = 12 mode = replace } }
    if = {
        limit = { character:oe_y7_xuanrang ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI } }
        character:oe_y7_xuanrang ?= { add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_title_regent years = -1 mode = replace } }
        if = {
            limit = { character:oe_y7_xuanrang ?= { has_unit = no } }
            location:dadu = { random_unit_in_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:CHI is_navy = no has_commander = no } set_as_commander = character:oe_y7_xuanrang } }
        }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: the emperor goes north; Dadu left to a regent (oe_y7_dadu 1)"
}
# .31 b: the capital held: oe_y7_dadu_stand (12 months), 6 regiments at Dadu, campaign 4 "守大都" (8 months).
oe_y7_job_d31b = {
    location:dadu = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_y7_dadu_stand months = 12 mode = replace } }
    location:dadu = { save_scope_as = oe_y7_aim } oe_y7_find_spot = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_y7_at } scope:oe_y7_at = { oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_li = yes oe_y7_u_hi = yes oe_y7_u_hi = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes oe_y7_u_hc = yes } debug_log = "oe_y7: 6 regiments (dd) raised for the Yuan" }
    oe_y7_start_camp = { n = 4 }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_campend add = 2 }
    debug_log = "oe_y7: the emperor holds Dadu (oe_y7_dadu 2); campaign 4 begins"
}
# .32 (every option): Dadu's modifiers, the regent's title and campaign 4 off; the epilogue (if it runs) ends with code 1.
oe_y7_job_d32 = {
    oe_y7_dadu_clear = yes
    debug_log = "oe_y7: the fate of Dadu decided (oe_y7_dadu 3, 4 or 5)"
    oe_y7_epi_close = { code = 1 }
}
# .32 b: the city fell with the emperor in it: every Yuan army loses half of its morale.
oe_y7_job_d32b = {
    every_unit = { limit = { is_navy = no } damage_unit_morale_percent = 0.5 }
    oe_y7_job_d32 = yes
}

# The line closes now as at 1368.1.1 (code 5) and the epilogue opens when the Yuan owns Dadu as its capital and .32 has not
# come (button y73epi). The epilogue goes on monthly only with the scheduler hook A; y7month runs one month of it.
oe_y7_test_epi = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_m value = oe_y7_m_now } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_s } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_s value = global_var:oe_y7_m } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_init } } set_global_variable = oe_y7_init }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_epi_end } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_epi_end }
    oe_y7_epi_open = yes
    oe_y7_finish = { code = 5 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_epi } debug_log = "oe_y7 TEST: the line closed (code 5); the epilogue runs" }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_y7 TEST: no epilogue (the Yuan does not own Dadu as its capital, or .32 has come)" }
}
# W-3 now, whatever the date and phase (button y73huai; needs the Prince of Xuanrang at the Yuan court: .1 makes the princes).
oe_y7_test_huai = {
    if = { limit = { character:oe_y7_xuanrang ?= { is_alive = yes owner ?= c:CHI } } oe_y7_w3_fx = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_y7 TEST: the Prince of Xuanrang is not at the Yuan court (y7rtr, y7start, y7month first: .1 makes the princes)" }
}
# The capital counts as pressed (button y73press): the war part of oe_y7_dadu_pressed is taken as true, .31 is due.
oe_y7_test_press = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_m value = oe_y7_m_now } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_t_press value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_press value = 2 }
    debug_log = "oe_y7 TEST: the capital counts as pressed (oe_y7_t_press)"
}
# The city counts as fallen (button y73fall; after .31 a or b).
oe_y7_test_fall = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_t_fall value = 1 }
    debug_log = "oe_y7 TEST: Dadu counts as fallen (oe_y7_t_fall)"
}
# The city counts as held (button y73held; after .31 b): no longer pressed, campaign 4 won.
oe_y7_test_held = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_t_press } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_t_press }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_y7_t_fall } remove_global_variable = oe_y7_t_fall }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp value = 4 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_y7_camp_ok value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = oe_y7_camp_done
    debug_log = "oe_y7 TEST: Dadu counts as held (campaign 4 won)"
}
